candidates.prompt: A cinematic lost jungle sanctuary in the style of Tomb Raider, photorealistic adventure-game environment. Retain the source temple's monumental carved towers, long columned gallery, central dark doorway and steep stone stairs in the same wide composition. Massive twisting banyan roots grip the large foreground tower, crawl down its carved walls and split the stair edges; hanging lianas drape from the roof and tower ledges. Thick emerald moss fills the stone joints, with small ferns sprouting from broken masonry. Preserve readable ancient carvings between the roots, with rain-darkened gray sandstone, chipped edges and damp highlights. Replace the exposed lawn on the left with dense layered ferns, broad tropical leaves and tangled roots surrounding a narrow broken-stone approach to the stairs. Towering rainforest trees rise behind and beside the temple; their interlocking canopy fills most of the formerly open sky and frames the towers. Foreground leaves frame the lower corners without obscuring the central architecture. Cool humid green shadows, drifting thin ground mist, and warm slanting sunlight through canopy gaps illuminate the main tower and stairs, revealing deep shadow inside the sanctuary doorway. Quiet, abandoned, mysterious archaeological grandeur, grounded natural materials, detailed cinematic depth. Maintain the steady source camera and consistent architecture throughout; leaves gently stir and mist drifts slowly. An empty sanctuary without people, text or interface.

Photographic textures and believable vegetation, cinematic depth, no plastic sheen. Remove tourists and modern traces; no added characters, text or interface. Maintain consistent exposure and color throughout. Only gentle leaf sway, drifting mist and natural cloud movement; architecture, roots, framing and vegetation placement remain stable across every frame.
